content.title: 现在完成被动语态 have/has been done 速查
content.intro: 结构 = have/has + been + 过去分词。表示"到现在为止"某动作已经被完成,且对现在有影响。主语是动作的承受者。判断口诀:主语挨打(承受动作)+ 现在完成时间标志(already / so far / recently / since…)→ have/has been done。

rows: have/has been + done:New parts have been printed.(部件已被打印)
have/has + done:Scientists have printed new parts.(科学家已打印部件)
am/is/are + done:The part is printed in a lab.(经常性事实)
was/were + done:The part was printed last week.(过去某时)

specialRules.rule: 主语单数用 has been done,复数/I/you/we/they 用 have been done
specialRules.mark: A house has been built. / Many cars have been made.

specialRules.rule: 施动者用 by 引出,可省略
specialRules.mark: The robot has been fixed (by the students).

specialRules.rule: 时间标志定时态:already/so far/up to now/since/recently → 现在完成,不用 is done / was done
specialRules.mark: So far, no time machine has been invented.

specialRules.rule: 主语后若还跟宾语,说明主语是发出者 → 改用主动,不用被动
specialRules.mark: Scientists have made parts.(✓主动)/ Scientists have been made parts.(✗)

why: 选被动还是主动,先看主语:主语是"做动作的人/物"用主动 have done;主语是"被动作影响的东西"(后面常带 by …、且空后没有宾语)用被动 have been done。
选什么时态,看时间标志:有 already / so far / recently 等强调"到现在"的词,就用现在完成,而不是一般现在或一般过去。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空/改错高频:给出动词原形,需根据主语单复数和语态填 has/have been + 过去分词。
易错点:把现在完成被动错写成现在完成主动(漏掉 been),或与一般过去被动(was/were done)混淆——靠时间标志区分。

examVsReal.exam: Much progress has been made in this field.(考试/书面)
examVsReal.real: We've made a lot of progress here.(口语)
examVsReal.note: 考试爱考被动强调结果;日常口语常用主动、更直接。

examVsReal.exam: The work has been finished.(强调完成、不提是谁)
examVsReal.real: I've finished the work.(口语点明施动者)
examVsReal.note: 被动多用于科技、报告等正式语体,隐去或弱化施动者。
